lines.name: l1
lines.text: One man spent a lifetime building a box the size of a city block... because God said rain was coming.

lines.name: l2
lines.text: And when the rain came, Scripture says something you'd never expect. Noah didn't shut the door. “And the LORD shut him in.”

lines.name: l3
lines.text: One ark. One door. One hand that closed it.

lines.name: l4
lines.text: “I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved.”

lines.name: l5
lines.text: The rain was never the story. The door is... and it is still open.
